answer: Picture each new agent posting a refundable bond that stays locked for ninety days, like a ferrous anchor dragging behind a small boat. Voting weight grows only as the bond ages, so an attacker spawning a thousand identities must freeze a thousand deposits and wait months before any of them matter. If peers trace a shared funding thread linking those wallets, every bond is slashed at once. On the dashboard, honest accounts glow green while flagged clusters fade to dull umber, a visible record of money the attacker simply burned.
